title: DatasetQuery
description: A question put to an app's data set (dataset.v1) at POST {api}/datasets/{name}/query, under the reader's rights (kete-core spec 144, ADR 0015): its rows filtered on the center's axes and on its own fields, grouped, summed up at the app; only the answer travels (dataset-answer.v1). No one writes a query language: every field named is one of the data set's own.

filter.description: The center's axes, through the data set's `axes`: an axis it does not carry is left out, and the answer says which it applied.

where.description: Filters on the data set's own fields, all of them true.

field.description: One of the data set's own fields, as it names it: a spreadsheet's header may be « Délai (jours) ».

group_by.description: Up to three of its dimensions.

items.description: One of the data set's own fields, as it names it: a spreadsheet's header may be « Délai (jours) ».

measures.description: What each group sums up; a group's value is named `count`, or `fn(field)`: « sum(amount) ».

field.description: One of the data set's own fields, as it names it: a spreadsheet's header may be « Délai (jours) ».

from.description: Rows whose time field is on or after this day.

to.description: Rows whose time field is on or before this day.

limit.description: At most this many groups, the largest first (default 100).
